messages.author: ba05d69fd7c406f3
messages.subject: plotting residuals for spatial models
parts:
Hi Facundo, 

I wonder if you could help with an issue I'm having in plotting residuals of my spatial models. 

I've tried plot(mod, 'residuals') as the overview document suggests, and I am getting the error: 
Error in !is.null(alist[[idx]]) && !suppressWarnings(is.na(alist[[idx]])) : 'length = 2' in coercion to 'logical(1)'

I would really appreciate any insight you might have into this issue! 

Thanks, 
Brianna

messages.author: 325fe6b6398fee79
messages.subject: Re: plotting residuals for spatial models
parts:
Hi all,
I have the same problem (also re-testing the code of a breedR training session that previously worked).

From the web (https://stackoverflow.com/questions/72848442/r-warning-lengthx-2-1-in-coercion-to-logical1), I understand that some change has been made in R 4.2.0 and later versions for the use of &, &&, | and || conditions, which can generate new error messages in the codes that previously worked.
Not sure I understood perfectly though...

=> is it the issue? does it mean that breedR shoud be used with a version of R earlier than 4.2.0?

Thanks,
François
